description: Search The Librarian's catalog (hybrid BM25 + dense, CJK-aware). Returns hits {id, kind, title, snippet, score, state, subjects[]} and next_cursor; use library_get for one entry in full.

cursor.description: Optional: next_cursor from the previous page.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

subject.description: Optional: restrict to entries carrying this subject slug.

name: library_search
